format: one JSONL file per n: certificates_n{n}.jsonl. Each line is {g6, e}, {g6, c} or {g6, k4: true}. Edges are the pairs (u, v) with u < v in the order produced by graph6.decode_graph6, which is the graph6 bit order: sorted by v, then by u, i.e. (0,1), (0,2), (1,2), (0,3), (1,3), (2,3), ...; each edge is oriented from u to v. {g6, e}: one-edge witness lambda = Pi epsilon_e for the edge with index e in this list. {g6, c}: three-phase colouring witness, a length-n list of 0/1/2, with lambda_c = Pi r_c and r_c(u,v) = wrap((c(v) - c(u))/3) in {0, 1/3, -1/3}. {g6, k4: true}: K4, excluded by design (mu(K4) = 1/2, so no witness below 1/2 exists).
